items.html: And know that all the corrections of the upper Ima entered within the body of ZA, and became a soul to him. And this is what is written: 'and from there it is drawn and flows in the whole body'; and therefore they are hidden. And this too is the meaning of 'He establishes the heavens by understanding.' And therefore Bina is called Binah, Ben Yud-Hey — her name is as the name of her son — and her six extremities are a soul to his six extremities.
